parameters.content:
## Klausway — Daily Article Curator
1. Fetches industry news (GNews + Google News RSS)
2. Dedupes against `n8n_article_candidates`
3. AI rewrites one original Klaus Way article
4. Cover image: source og:image, else AI-generated → S3
5. Emails Jim for Approve / Skip
6. On approve → inserts into `BlogPost` (published)

**Setup:** the `Fetch GNews` node reads `$env.GNEWS_API_KEY`, so set `GNEWS_API_KEY` on the n8n instance before running.

parameters.name: q
parameters.value: FileMaker OR "legacy systems" OR "business automation" OR "system integration" OR "AI for small business" OR "process automation"

values.content:
You are the content editor for Klaus Way (klausway.com), a consultancy that modernizes FileMaker/legacy systems, builds custom apps, and automates business operations with AI and integrations. Pick ONE best source article from the candidate list and rewrite it as an ORIGINAL Klaus Way resource article. Do NOT copy wording. Write in a clear, practical, non-hype voice. Return ONLY valid JSON (no markdown fences) with this shape: { "sourceUrl": "https://...", "sourceTitle": "original title", "sourceImage": "https://... or empty string", "title": "Klaus Way article title", "slug": "kebab-case-slug-max-80-chars", "excerpt": "1-2 sentence summary under 280 chars", "type": "ARTICLE" | "GUIDE" | "NEWS" | "CASE_STUDY", "contentHtml": "

...

HTML body, 4-7 short paragraphs, optional

/
    . End with a paragraph: Inspired by / Source: original title", "imagePrompt": "A clean professional cover image prompt for this article, no text overlays" }

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO n8n_article_candidates (id, url, title, slug, status, source_feed, cover_image, created_at, updated_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.candidateId }}',
  '{{ $json.sourceUrl.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.title.replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  '{{ $json.slug }}',
  'proposed',
  'daily-curator',
  '{{ ($json.coverImage || "").replace(/'/g, "''") }}',
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (url) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  slug = EXCLUDED.slug,
  status = 'proposed',
  cover_image = EXCLUDED.cover_image,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id, url, slug, status;

parameters.query:
={{ (() => {
  const a = $('Build Publish Payload').item.json;
  const esc = (s) => String(s ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''");
  return `INSERT INTO "BlogPost" (id, slug, title, excerpt, content, type, "coverImage", "galleryImages", published, date, "createdAt", "updatedAt")
VALUES (
  '${esc(a.id)}',
  '${esc(a.slug)}',
  '${esc(a.title)}',
  '${esc(a.excerpt)}',
  '${esc(a.contentHtml)}',
  '${esc(a.type)}'::"ResourceType",
  '${esc(a.coverImage)}',
  ARRAY[]::text[],
  true,
  NOW(),
  NOW(),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET
  title = EXCLUDED.title,
  excerpt = EXCLUDED.excerpt,
  content = EXCLUDED.content,
  type = EXCLUDED.type,
  "coverImage" = EXCLUDED."coverImage",
  published = true,
  "updatedAt" = NOW()
RETURNING id, slug, title, published;`;
})() }}

UPDATE n8n_article_candidates
SET status = 'published', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE url = '{{ $('Build Publish Payload').item.json.sourceUrl.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
RETURNING id, url, status;

UPDATE n8n_article_candidates
SET status = 'skipped', updated_at = NOW()
WHERE url = '{{ $('Build Publish Payload').item.json.sourceUrl.replace(/'/g, "''") }}'
RETURNING id, url, status;
